description: This file defines the interface TbDeviceService for managing device-related operations in the Thingsboard platform, including saving, deleting, assigning, and claiming devices.

classes.name: TbDeviceService
classes.description: Interface defining device management operations such as save, delete, assign, and claim devices.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a device with an access token for a user.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a device with an access token and a name conflict strategy for a user.

methods.name: saveDeviceWithCredentials
methods.description: Saves a device along with its credentials.

methods.name: saveDeviceWithCredentials
methods.description: Saves a device with credentials and a name conflict strategy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a device for a user.

methods.name: assignDeviceToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a device to a customer within a tenant.

methods.name: unassignDeviceFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes the association of a device from a customer.

methods.name: assignDeviceToPublicCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a device to the public customer.

methods.name: claimDevice
methods.description: Claims a device for a customer asynchronously.

methods.name: assignDeviceToTenant
methods.description: Assigns a device to a new tenant.

methods.name: assignDeviceToEdge
methods.description: Assigns a device to an edge.

methods.name: unassignDeviceFromEdge
methods.description: Removes a device from an edge.
